facts.fact: Mwananchi reports that Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Commission, headed by director general Dr Emmanuel Mkilia, has received many complaints about phone-on-credit lenders and is investigating.

TZA.note: An investigation opened is not a ruling.

facts.fact: Mwananchi reports that Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Commission, headed by director general Dr Emmanuel Mkilia, is acting on complaints about lenders' use of borrowers' personal data.

TZA.note: The law itself is not named or dated; the investigation is not a decision.
